description: Manage git worktrees under worktreesDir. For each run: compute a deterministic worktree path from the target (e.g. worktreesDir/{owner}-{repo}-issue-123). If the worktree does not exist, run git worktree add <path> <branch>. If it already exists, reuse it. Expose worktree path and branch to the agent runner. Remove worktree entry from state on run completion (but do not delete the directory — that is operator cleanup).
title: Worktree lifecycle (create, reuse, path management)
